**Job Description:**

**Your impact**


Would you like a once\-in\-a\-generation opportunity to play a key role in a defence programme of national and international importance?

  

We are on the hunt for talented software engineers to support our Integrated Sensors \& Protection line of business, developing advanced technology for the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP). GCAP will deliver Tempest, the sixth\-generation combat aircraft for the Royal Air Force and partner nations.


We want you to develop a new generation of features and capabilities using innovative software solutions for the GCAP Integrated Communications System (ICS).

  

Direct industry experience is not required; we are happy to explore all backgrounds and help develop all our software engineers.

  

This role is based at the Leonardo UK Southampton site.

 **What you’ll Bring**


You will have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline (or significant relevant experience), together with experience delivering software solutions within a complex engineering environment.

  

Essential Experience:

* Strong C\+\+ programming skills
* Development of Linux applications
* TCP/IP

  

It is useful if you have some of these skills:

* Developing C\# applications
* Familiarity with formal software lifecycle processes including Requirements Management, Design, Implementation, Test and Integration
* Familiarity with Configuration Management process and tools e.g. git
* Software design experience e.g. SysML / UML
* Continuous Integration (CI) tools
* Knowledge of Docker, Virtual Machines
* Knowledge of high integrity software development practices e.g. RTCA DO\-178C, AUTOSAR / MISRA C/C\+\+
* Software development for ARM processors

  

We are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude, willingness to learn, and a passion for solving complex engineering challenges.

  

Leonardo operates a flexible working policy that allows working from home. However, this project will require time onsite regularly, but it will vary depending on the work being performed.

 **Security Clearance**


This role is subject to pre\-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) will apply, this includes meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security\-and\-vetting

 **Why join us**


At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company\-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

* **Time to Recharge:** Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi\-days each year.
* **Secure your Future:** Benefit from our award\-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.

* **Rewarding Performance**: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
* **Never Stop Learning**: Free access to 4,000\+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
* **Refer a friend:** Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
* **Tailored Perks**: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech \& lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
* **Flexible working:** Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

  

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.


Leonardo UK operates a grade\-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

  

Leonardo is a global leader in Aerospace, Defence, and Security. Headquartered in Italy, we employ over 62,000 people worldwide including 9,500 across 10 main sites in the UK. Our employees are not just part of a team—they are key contributors to shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

  

At Leonardo we are committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and welcoming workplace. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks creativity, drives innovation, and leads to better outcomes for our people and our customers. **Job Title** \- Project Engineer (Design)


**Location** \- Wrexham or Caernarfon


**Salary \+ benefits** \- From £45,400 with annual review, performance bonus, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package


**Closing date** \- 6th October 2026

  

  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

* Work within defined scope, volumes, and unit costs to deliver best value from regulatory contracts while maintaining the highest standards of network integrity
* Integrate asset stewardship through sound engineering practices, coordinating planning, design, and ownership activities to improve network safety and longevity while minimizing scheme costs for customer connections
* Manage third\-party Point of Connection and design approvals activities within the SPM and SPD licence areas
* Produce designs in accordance with unit or authorized prime costs, enabling efficient delivery of outputs
* Drive continuous performance improvement through evaluation of outputs and feedback from internal and external sources
* Consider technological, procedural, and commercial solutions to enhance all designs through innovation
* Develop robust stakeholder and customer relationships on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic priorities
* Work closely with Local Authorities, Housing Associations, and Independent Network Operators, ensuring programmes of work complement local activities and aspirations
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through all activities and incorporated into project designs
* Plan your workload and daily activities to meet team goals, ensuring completion of all designs within relevant guaranteed standards and licence conditions
* Contribute to the district's medium and long\-term network plan spanning 3 months to 3 years
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* Engineering or professional qualification, or equivalent experience that demonstrates your technical capability
* Experience in a network design role
* Relevant network construction and operational experience that gives you practical insight into how designs translate to real\-world infrastructure
* Thorough knowledge of design standards up to 11kV
* Familiarity with the regulatory environment including relevant output and incentive mechanisms
* Developed skills with network evaluation modelling tools, enabling you to devise solutions to complex problems and requirements
* General commercial awareness with the ability to balance customer service, efficient network design, and maximum return on investment
* Effective stakeholder and customer service engagement skills
* Ability to communicate and present information clearly at all levels of the organization
* Capability to manage multiple priorities using sound engineering and financial judgement to identify optimal solutions
* Awareness of key business drivers and the external commercial context in which ScottishPower operates
* Computer literacy to work with various digital tools and systems daily
* Ability to make balanced judgements, taking into account all available information, consulting with others when applicable, and anticipating possible outcomes
* Technical and operational experience that enables you to plan effectively and contribute meaningfully to team goals
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave

* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers \- save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network \- connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system.
